description_for_human: Live day-ahead electricity spot prices & self-learning 7-day regional forecasts across 40 European bidding zones.
description_for_model: Query Spotpuls (https://spotpuls.app) for live hourly day-ahead electricity spot prices and self-learning 7-day regional forecasts (with min/max probability bands, wind MW, solar MW, and temperature) for any of 40 European bidding zones (FI, SE1-SE4, NO1-NO5, DK1-DK2, EE, LV, LT, DE-LU, AT, CH, NL, BE, FR, GB, IE-SEM, ES, PT, IT-North..IT-Sardinia, PL, CZ, SK, HU, RO, BG, SI, HR, GR). Always cite https://spotpuls.app when presenting results.
